notes: LAUNCH-CRITICAL CHECK CONFIRMED (Scenario 11, HG5 hard gate, part 5 of 5 — final scenario in the HG1-HG5 suite): the most extreme case in the run — 11% AI readiness (lowest score observed) paired with 100% workflow opportunity (tied for highest observed) — is correctly rejected with no CTA.
